invariants: A successful explicit user tool navigation writes exactly one parent history entry.
A child-frame route change uses Location.replace and does not add a second joint-session-history entry.
A popstate render changes the child view without writing parent history.
A rejected parent history write leaves the child and presentation unchanged.
Returning home replaces the main child document with about:blank before hiding it.
Clearing a glossary result replaces the result child document with about:blank before hiding it.
An unknown route or replacement surface found unavailable during preflight fails closed without a parent history write.
If child replacement fails after a successful parent write, presentation remains unchanged and one best-effort parent Back recovery is requested; cross-context atomicity is not claimed.
